sharedScenario.title: Choosing a Gym Access Plan for the Comparison Window
sharedScenario.description: You need gym access for the duration given by {{comparisonMonths}} and are deciding between a Year Card (pay {{optionA_payment}} every {{optionA_periodMonths}} months) and a Month Card (pay {{optionB_payment}} each month). Both give the same gym entry with no extra fees. {{subscriptionCostComparison}}

optionA.beginning: You sign up for the Year Card, paying {{optionA_payment}} upfront for the first {{optionA_periodMonths}} months of access.
optionA.during: After some time, you use the gym regularly, swiping your card at the entrance each visit without worrying about extra charges.
optionA.later: When the initial period ends, you pay another {{optionA_payment}} to renew, giving you coverage that extends well beyond the comparison window.
optionA.advice: Note the renewal date so you can prepare the second {{optionA_payment}} before your current term ends.

optionB.beginning: You start with the Month Card, paying {{optionB_payment}} for the first month of gym access.
optionB.during: Later, your schedule changes and you attend less often; you still pay {{optionB_payment}} each month but can choose to skip a month if you pause.
optionB.later: At the end of the comparison window you have paid the total for {{optionB_paymentCount}} months and stop the subscription because you no longer need access.
optionB.advice: Set a monthly reminder to review your usage and decide whether to continue, pause, or cancel before each new {{optionB_payment}} is due.
